corrections.correction: Eq. (1) describes a density-normalized evolution variable, not the instantaneous fraction of total density. The paper explicitly defines fEDE(ac)=Omega_phi(ac)/Omega_tot(ac). Replacing Omega_phi(a) by fEDE(a) changes the model. The precise fixed critical-density convention is not spelled out in this letter; verify the cited fluid implementation before reproducing its Omega_phi,0 parameter. For a proposed toy test use an explicitly defined physical rho_phi and normalize f at ac.

Not every fitted variant dilutes faster than radiation: n=2 gives w=1/3 and rho~a^-4; integer n>=3 gives faster dilution; n→infinity gives w=1 and rho~a^-6. n=1 is matter-like and the paper reports a dedicated unsuccessful tension fit. Use radiation-like or faster for the broad family.

corrections.correction: Detailed slow-roll microphysics was deferred, but the letter did include its effective-fluid limit n→infinity with rest-frame cs²=1 and states numerical scalar evolution confirms that description. Do not say the slow-roll case was wholly unanalyzed, or identify it with an n=3 oscillator. The early linear potential asymptotes to zero; its full functional form is absent.

corrections.correction: Luna copied the printed source faithfully. The source gives ell_X=pi D_A/r_X and then ell_s/ell_D=r_s/r_D. Algebra requires ell_s/ell_D=r_D/r_s, equivalently ell_D/ell_s=r_s/r_D, if one distance/length convention is used. Preserve the printed equation as source_claim and store this reciprocal as a repaired identity. The quoted omega_cdm^0.03 scaling must be re-derived before implementation; it cannot be assigned unchanged to both ratios.

source_claim.expression: ell_X=pi D_A/r_X; ell_s/ell_D=r_s/r_D proportional to omega_cdm^0.03

corrections.correction: The tabulated fraction is at the transition scale ac. It is not automatically the maximum instantaneous EDE fraction; the maximum also depends on evolving total density. log10(ac)=-3.737 corresponds to zc≈5.46e3 through a0=1. The qualitative z≈5000 is consistent with this rounding.

corrections.correction: Listed values are correctly transcribed conditional posterior means/1σ summaries, not measurements of EDE. Evidence uses the lite high-ell likelihood and priors, whereas Table I best fits use the stated combined datasets. No current resolution or likelihood reproduction is established.

The positive jump in Eq. (7b) uses [f]_±=f_before-f_after, Eq. (6). Hence Hdot_after-Hdot_before=-4piG(1+w*)rho*. Density and H are continuous; pressure/Hdot change. Omitting the jump convention risks reversing the physical matching. Dots use cosmic time t, not conformal time.
corrections.display_summary: NEDE uses a before-minus-after jump convention; omitting it reverses the apparent sign of the pressure-induced H-dot change.

corrections.correction: Eqs. (14a,b) are synchronous-gauge initial conditions with cosmic-time derivatives, comoving k and the paper theta convention; theta is not an arbitrary velocity scalar. delta_phi/phidot has time units, H times this is dimensionless and k²/a times this has inverse-time units when c=1. H(z*)=0.2m and log10(m×Mpc) use inverse-length/natural units: eV masses require hbar,c conversion before numerical H in km/s/Mpc.

corrections.correction: No-SH0ES and Planck-only fits in this letter fix log10(m×Mpc)=2.58 to avoid the fNEDE→0 sampling-volume artifact. They are not the same fully free eight-parameter model as the combined fit. The combined implementation also fixes w*=cs²=2/3, H/m=0.2 and phi_ini/Mpl=1e-4, and assumes no sizeable residual trigger oscillations. Record all before comparing significance or evidence.

corrections.correction: Text defines ΔlogB then reports ΔB=5.5. Preserve that source shorthand but identify 5.5 as the stated logarithmic evidence difference, not a Bayes factor of 5.5. Priors and fixed-parameter choices condition it.

Several chosen MLCS samples favor TS, but Table 6 cut Gold remains ln B=-1.18 at z>=0.033; MLCS17 +0.57 and SDSS-II +0.53 are weak positive differences. Common-object selection and further exclusions alter the evidence. Never promote a blanket MLCS-favors-TS rule or pool overlapping samples as independent support.
corrections.display_summary: The historical MLCS samples do not all favour timescape. Overlapping samples, reductions, priors and cuts must stay separate.

corrections.correction: Wall-observer acceleration is a dressed model quantity defined with wall proper time and effective geometry; it is not a direct measurement of an accelerating physical local scale factor or an exact inhomogeneous Einstein solution. The volume-average time t differs from tau. Preserve this distinction rather than mapping an inferred FLRW w(z) onto physical TS matter.

Eq. (22) uses the combined nuisance normalization script M, with absolute M and H0 mixed by Eq. (21). Store it separately from intrinsic absolute magnitude M. The packet uses the same plain M symbol, which obscures this calibration degeneracy.

Use either value 38 with unit percent or value 0.38 with unit fraction; the packet string ≈38% with unit fraction is ambiguous. This is a cited model example, not a fitted new clock-rate measurement. The lapse gamma is dimensionless.
corrections.display_summary: The extracted clock-rate example mixes percent and fraction notation; it is a model illustration, not a new measurement.
